reason: Promote to active, scoped to Codex and generated AGENTS.md. Official Codex docs confirm project_doc_max_bytes defaults to 32KiB, that file concatenation stops at the limit, and that no truncation warning is documented. The Ruler issue (#791) gives a concrete reproduction: only 4 of 6 parts were visible at 50,837 bytes, and 4.6% of an 857KB output reached the model. Official documentation and the reproduction agree. The issue is open with no upstream fix recorded. RMD-INSTRSIZE-001 (CI byte-size check, important rules first, nested split) is a current known-applicable remedy.

evidence.summary: 32KiB default project_doc_max_bytes; stops adding files at the limit; no truncation warning documented.
Silent tail drop reproduced; issue open, no fix.
candidate/known-applicable; CI byte-limit check, put critical rules first, nested AGENTS.md split.

model_assessment.assessment: Harness-level truncation happens before the model sees the instructions, so model improvement cannot fix it.

remedy_assessment.assessment: Current and low-cost. It is directly applicable wherever generated AGENTS.md is consumed by Codex.

reopen_triggers: Codex adds a truncation warning or changes the default limit
a similar silent size cap is reported in another harness
